items.title: Maple Leaf Wreath
items.alt: An open circular twig wreath carries amber and russet maple leaves with a small cluster of paired winged seeds.
items.description: An open circular twig wreath carries amber and russet maple leaves with a small cluster of paired winged seeds. An original maple illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.
